title: Customer-oriented launch playbook: RBAC + Audit Logs + KMS (enablement & release notes coordination)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: Produce an end-to-end launch playbook and coordinated release notes for Private/VPC/on-prem customers for three security-critical features (RBAC, audit logging, KMS key management). Scope covers cross-team launch tasks: release notes, sales/solutions enablement, support runbooks, legal/compliance signoff, telemetry keys, and staged rollouts. Outcomes: (1) single operational runbook used by Support/SE/Onboarding, (2) customer-facing release notes and migration guidance, (3) internal GTM checklist and comms cadence. Success metrics: on-time release notes publication, <2 support P1s in first 30 days, completion of training for 95% of SEs before GA.
acceptance_criteria: Published customer-facing release notes with step-by-step migration guidance and known limitations
Runbook (support + ops) with rollback steps, emergency contacts, and playbook for audits
KMS onboarding checklist validated by Security and Legal; SSO/RBAC mapping doc approved
Training session recorded and attendance list; enablement slides shared with Sales/SEs
Telemetry keys instrumented and dashboard links included in comms

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Customers have diverse KMS setups (cloud/HSM) — Mitigation: publish compatibility matrix and provide migration checklist
Risk: Ambiguous RBAC mapping for existing orgs — Mitigation: provide example mapping templates and offer 1:1 onboarding for top-10 customers
Risk: Audit log volume causing storage cost surprises — Mitigation: default retention + cost-estimation calculator in release notes
Risk: Delay in Security signoff — Mitigation: weekly reviews and pre-approved fallback configuration for GA
